patch_description:
This implementation replaces iterative replica selection with a vectorized discrete water-filling formulation: every possible additional replica contributes a marginal load value `weight / replica_rank`, and selecting the globally largest marginal values produces the minimax-optimal replica counts for the fixed replica budget.

Physical replicas are then placed with capacity-constrained LPT scheduling, followed by a bounded best-improving cross-GPU swap pass. This jointly improves per-expert replica balance and GPU load balance while avoiding the repeated per-replica `max(weight / count)` loop used previously. Group-to-node placement retains hierarchical locality when possible.
